15: class AzureDevopsLeadTimeForChanges(AzureDevopsIssues):
16:     """Collector to calculate lead time for changes from Azure Devops Server."""
17: 
18:     def _item_select_fields(self) -> list[str]:
19:         """Also request date fields to calculate lead time."""
20:         base_fields = super()._item_select_fields()
21:         return base_fields + ["System.CreatedDate", "System.ChangedDate"]
22: 
23:     def _include_issue(self, issue: dict) -> bool:
24:         """Return whether this issue should be counted."""
25:         if not issue["fields"]["System.State"] in ["Closed", "Done"]:
26:             return False
27: 
28:         finished_date = issue["fields"].get("System.ChangedDate")  # TODO - how to find out System.State update ?
29:         if not finished_date:
30:             return False
31: 
32:         return days_ago(parse(finished_date)) <= int(cast(str, self._parameter("lookback_days")))
33: 
34:     async def _parse_value(self, responses: SourceResponses) -> Value:
35:         work_items = (await self._work_items(responses))
36:         if not work_items:
37:             return None
38: 
39:         lead_times = [self.__lead_time(item) for item in work_items]
40:         return str(round(mean(lead_times)))
41: 
42:     async def _parse_entities(self, responses: SourceResponses) -> Entities:
43:         """Override to add the story points to the entities."""
44:         return Entities(
45:             Entity(
46:                 key=work_item["id"],
47:                 project=work_item["fields"]["System.TeamProject"],
48:                 title=work_item["fields"]["System.Title"],
49:                 work_item_type=work_item["fields"]["System.WorkItemType"],
50:                 state=work_item["fields"]["System.State"],
51:                 url=work_item["_links"]["html"]["href"],
52:                 lead_time=self.__lead_time(work_item),
53:             )
54:             for work_item in await self._work_items(responses)
55:         )
56: 
57:     @staticmethod
58:     def __lead_time(work_item: dict[str, dict[str, str]]) -> int:
59:         """Return the lead time of a completed work item."""
60:         changed_date = parse(work_item["fields"]["System.ChangedDate"])
61:         created_date = parse(work_item["fields"]["System.CreatedDate"])
62:         return (changed_date - created_date).days

1: """Azure DevOps Server issues collector."""
2: 
3: from typing import Final
4: 
5: import aiohttp
6: 
7: from base_collectors import SourceCollector

9: from collector_utilities.type import URL, Value, Responses

13: class AzureDevopsIssues(SourceCollector):
14:     """Collector to get issues from Azure Devops Server."""
15: 
16:     MAX_IDS_PER_WORK_ITEMS_API_CALL: Final[int] = 200  # See
17:     # https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work%20items/list?view=azure-devops-rest-5.1
18: 
19:     _issue_ids_to_fetch: list[int]
20: 
21:     async def _api_url(self) -> URL:
22:         """Extend to add the WIQL or WorkItems API path."""
23:         return URL(f"{await super()._api_url()}/_apis/wit/wiql?api-version=6.0")
24: 
25:     def _api_list_query(self) -> dict[str, str]:
26:         """Combine API select and where fields to correct WIQL query."""
27:         wiql_query_segments = [f"Select [System.Id] From WorkItems"]
28:         wiql_parameter = self._parameter("wiql")
29:         if wiql_parameter:
30:             if not wiql_parameter.startswith("WHERE"):
31:                 wiql_query_segments.append("WHERE")
32:             wiql_query_segments.append(wiql_parameter)
33:         return dict(query=" ".join(wiql_query_segments))
34: 
35:     def _item_select_fields(self) -> list[str]:
36:         """Return the API fields to select for individual issues."""
37:         return ["System.TeamProject", "System.Title", "System.WorkItemType", "System.State"]
38: 
39:     async def _get_work_item_responses(self, auth: aiohttp.BasicAuth) -> SourceResponses:
40:         """Separately get each work item from the API."""
41:         api_url = URL((await self._api_url()).replace('wit/wiql', 'wit/workitemsbatch'))
42:         batch_size = min(self.MAX_IDS_PER_WORK_ITEMS_API_CALL, SourceMeasurement.MAX_ENTITIES)
43:         id_iter = iterable_to_batches(self._issue_ids_to_fetch, batch_size)
44:         responses = [
45:             await self._session.post(api_url, auth=auth,
46:                                      json={"ids": id_batch, "fields": self._item_select_fields(), "$expand": "links"})
47:             for id_batch in id_iter
48:         ]
49:         return SourceResponses(responses=responses, api_url=api_url)
50: 
51:     async def _get_source_responses(self, *urls: URL, **kwargs) -> SourceResponses:
52:         """Override because we need to do a post request and need to separately get the entities."""
53:         api_url = urls[0]
54:         auth = aiohttp.BasicAuth(str(self._parameter("private_token")))
55:         response = await self._session.post(api_url, auth=auth, json=self._api_list_query())
56:         self._issue_ids_to_fetch = [work_item["id"] for work_item in (await response.json()).get("workItems", [])]
57:         if not self._issue_ids_to_fetch:
58:             return SourceResponses(responses=[response], api_url=api_url)
59:         work_items = await self._get_work_item_responses(auth)
60:         work_items.insert(0, response)
61:         return work_items
62: 
63:     async def _parse_entities(self, responses: SourceResponses) -> Entities:
64:         """Override to parse the work items from the WIQL query response."""
65:         return Entities(
66:             Entity(
67:                 key=work_item["id"],
68:                 project=work_item["fields"]["System.TeamProject"],
69:                 title=work_item["fields"]["System.Title"],
70:                 work_item_type=work_item["fields"]["System.WorkItemType"],
71:                 state=work_item["fields"]["System.State"],
72:                 url=work_item["_links"]["html"]["href"],
73:             )
74:             for work_item in await self._work_items(responses)
75:         )
76: 
77:     async def _parse_value(self, responses: SourceResponses) -> Value:
78:         """Override to parse the value from the responses.
79: 
80:         We can't just count the entities because due to pagination the response may not contain all work items.
81:         """
82:         return str(len(self._issue_ids_to_fetch))
83: 
84:     def _include_issue(self, issue: dict) -> bool:  # pylint: disable=unused-argument # skipcq: PYL-R0201
85:         """Return whether this issue should be counted."""
86:         return True
87: 
88:     async def _work_items(self, responses: SourceResponses) -> list[dict]:
89:         """Return the work items, if any."""
90:         if len(responses) <= 1:  # the first call is to workItems, which only returns ids
91:             return []
92:         all_work_items = []
93:         for response in responses[1:]:
94:             response_json = (await response.json())
95:             if not response_json:
96:                 continue
97:             all_work_items.extend(response_json.get("value"))
98:         return [work_item for work_item in all_work_items if self._include_issue(work_item)]

2: 
3: from collections.abc import Iterable
4: import re
5: 
6: 
7: QUOTED_SLASH = re.compile("%2f", re.IGNORECASE)
8: 
9: 
10: class Entity(dict):
11:     """Class to hold information about an individual measurement entity, e.g. one violation, or one security warning."""
12: 
13:     def __init__(self, key: str, **attributes) -> None:
14:         kwargs = dict(key=self.safe_entity_key(key))
15:         kwargs.update(**attributes)
16:         super().__init__(**kwargs)
17: 
18:     @staticmethod
19:     def safe_entity_key(key: str) -> str:
20:         """Return an escaped version of the key that is safe in URLs and as Mongo document key."""
21:         return re.sub(QUOTED_SLASH, "-", str(key).replace("/", "-").replace(".", "_"))
22: 
23: 
24: class Entities(list[Entity]):
25:     """Class to hold a list of unique entities."""
26: 
27:     def __init__(self, entities: Iterable[Entity] = ()):
28:         """Extend to filter duplicate entities."""
29:         super().__init__()
30:         self.__keys: set[str] = set()  # Keep track of the keys in a set to make adding entities faster
31:         self.extend(entities)
32: 
33:     def __add__(self, other):
34:         """Return the concatenation of the entities."""
35:         return self.__class__(super().__add__(other))
36: 
37:     def __getitem__(self, item):
38:         """Override to return an Entities slice or an Entity."""
39:         return self.__class__(super().__getitem__(item)) if isinstance(item, slice) else super().__getitem__(item)
40: 
41:     def append(self, entity: Entity) -> None:
42:         """Extend to only append the entity if it's not already in the list."""
43:         if (key := entity["key"]) not in self.__keys:
44:             self.__keys.add(key)
45:             super().append(entity)
46: 
47:     def extend(self, entities: Iterable[Entity]) -> None:
48:         """Extend to only add entities that aren't already in the list."""
49:         for entity in entities:
50:             self.append(entity)
